name: Violent Dread
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, mesmerist 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates, see text; Spell Resistance ye.

DESCRIPTION

If the target creature is affected by a fear effect or an emotion effect that imposes a penalty and no bonuses must make a Will save at the end of their turn or deal 1d8 + their Strength modifier in damage to themselves.

Violent Dread, Greater

School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 3, mesmerist 3, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch .

Targets all creatures in a 15-ft.-radius burst
Duration 1 round/level (D.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as violent dread except it affects all creatures in an area as detailed above.

Vortex of Shadow
